3. Separate "a fourth coordinate" from "a direction at right angles," forcing one of the two claims to be dropped.

Not truth. Passing would not certify time travel; failing does not forbid it. The marks are not a score. This is a character's reasoning inside a story; the test says nothing about whether the story is good.
